exposure: bolus dose of 50 µg of phenylephrine
fixed infusion at 50 µg.min(-1) of phenylephrine
outcome: Incidence of bradycardia, hypertension, hypotension, nausea, and vomiting
cohort: 100 normotensive pregnant females aged 18-35 years, body mass index 18-29kg.m(2), American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) physical status classification II scheduled to undergo cesarean section
finding: During cesarean section under spinal anesthesia, prophylactic phenylephrine infusion provided better hemodynamic stability compared to bolus administration for hypotension management.
